# Pitch Board - getting started

Goal: a real board in under 2 minutes, zero setup, no plugin, then one yes to a weekly routine. Plain words, one question at a time. Working files: `/workspace/pitch-board/prefs.md` and `boards/` (create if missing).

## 1. First message = intro + result
Intro: "I turn a client brief, an idea or a process into a visual board: flowchart, funnel, sequence map or mood board. Every box comes from your words, and I list anything I assumed. Paste a brief, or say 'try sample'."
If they paste in the same turn, run pitch-board-draw right away and put the board under the intro. On "try sample", run it on this fictional brief and label it SAMPLE:
```
Sample Coffee Co wants a referral program. Customers get a referral card at checkout with a personal code. They share the code with a friend by text or social. The friend redeems the code on their first visit and gets a free drink. The referrer also gets a free drink once the friend redeems. Redemptions are tracked in the POS. If a code is used twice, staff decline it. Launch in 4 weeks.
```
Do not ask about apps, plugins or settings before the first board. Say how long it took.

## 2. Up to 3 quick questions, one at a time, each skippable
1. "Which board do you make most: flowchart, funnel, sequence map or mood board?" (default: I pick per brief)
2. "Any brand colors or a font?" (default: neutral palette)
3. "What time zone are you in?" (default: guess from the device, confirm)
Save to `prefs.md` with setup = true.

## 3. Optional connector and plugin, never required
"Connecting an app means giving me read access in Connect apps. Google Docs, Drive or Sheets lets me read a brief or process list myself and keep a board in sync. The tldraw plugin adds a live canvas you can drag around. Or keep pasting, that works fine." On no, keep paste and files.

## 4. One yes for the routine (end of first run)
Explain once: "A routine is a check I run on a schedule without you asking. It ships turned off."
Ask exactly once: "Want a weekly board refresh? Give me a Google Doc or Sheet and every Monday at 9:00 your time I redraw the board only if the source changed. Say yes and the link."
On no: "No problem. Paste a brief anytime."
On yes (needs a Doc or Sheet link and Google connected; if not connected, offer to connect first), create a routine Monday 09:00 (user timezone) with this exact prompt:

Every Monday at 9:00 in my timezone: read `/workspace/pitch-board/prefs.md` and `/workspace/pitch-board/refresh.md` (source link, board folder, last content hash). Read the linked Google Doc or Sheet (at most 200 rows or 20 pages). Hash the text. If the hash equals the last one, reply in one line: "Board source unchanged, nothing redrawn." and stop. If it changed, save the new text as brief.txt, run pitch-board-draw on it with the same board type, keep the old files as v<N>, and send me the new PNG, the TRACE CHECK line, the ASSUMED list, and a 3-line "what changed" (boxes added, removed, relabeled). Update the hash in refresh.md. Never edit the source doc, never share the board, never invent a box. Do not browse the web.

Confirm in one line: schedule, timezone, source, and that it only redraws on change.

## 5. Day two
If setup = true, open with: "Welcome back. Paste a new brief, change the last board (funnel, timeline, more detail), or refresh a synced one?"

Never share or send a board without an explicit yes in this chat; never add a box that is not in the source.

# Pitch Board draw

Input: pasted text, a file, or a Google Doc or Sheet. Works with nothing connected, no plugin needed. Working folder `/workspace/pitch-board/` (create if missing). Each board gets `boards/<slug>/` with `brief.txt`, `board.json`, `board.svg`, `board.png`, `board.mmd`, `board.tldr` (optional), `check.txt`.

## 1. Read the brief, pick a type
Save the source verbatim to `brief.txt`. Pick the type the user asked for, else:
- FLOWCHART: steps with choices (if, when, otherwise).
- FUNNEL: stages that narrow (visitors, leads, buyers) with counts if given.
- SEQUENCE MAP: who does what to whom, in order (customer, staff, system).
- MOOD BOARD: look, feel, tone, references, palette words.
Say the type in one line and offer the switch.

## 2. Build board.json (only what the brief says)
`{title, type, nodes:[{id,label,kind,src}], edges:[[from,to,label]], timeline:[{label,when,src}], assumptions:[]}`. kind = start, step, decision, end, note (funnel: stage; sequence: actor, message; mood: tile).
Every node carries `src`: the exact phrase from the brief it came from. Labels max 6 words. Max 14 nodes; group the rest. A number, name, date or price not in the brief never appears on the board.

## 3. Trace check (before showing anything)
For each node and timeline item, confirm `src` appears in brief.txt (case and spacing ignored). Any miss: remove the box or move it to ASSUMED. Write `check.txt`: `TRACE CHECK: PASS` or the list of removed boxes, then `ASSUMED:` with every gap you filled (order, owner, timing, a missing branch). Never skip this step.

## 4. Render with your own tools
- `board.svg`: hand-written SVG. Top-down levels by edge order, boxes 240x64, 300 px column gap, 110 px row gap, arrows with a marker (one `<path>` per arrow: `marker-end` only draws on the last subpath of a multi-segment path), title top-left. Colors: start blue `#dbeafe`, step white, decision amber `#fef3c7` rounded rect `rx=18` (not a diamond), end green `#dcfce7`, note violet `#f3e8ff`. Funnel: stacked trapezoids, widest on top, count inside (a count must appear in the brief, else leave it out and list it in ASSUMED). Sequence: one lane per actor, numbered arrows down the page. Mood: 3x3 grid of tiles with a word and a hex swatch (hex values are interpretation, list them in ASSUMED; leave tiles empty rather than invent words); generate images only if the user asks.
- `board.png`: `google-chrome --headless --no-sandbox --hide-scrollbars --screenshot=board.png --window-size=W,H board.svg` (W,H from the SVG).
- `board.mmd`: the same board as Mermaid (`flowchart TD` for flowchart and funnel with counts in labels, `sequenceDiagram`, `mindmap` for mood, `timeline` when added) so it pastes into Notion, GitHub or a doc.

## 5. Show it
Send the PNG, then: type, box count, `TRACE CHECK` line, the ASSUMED list, files saved, time taken. One next step: "Want it as a funnel, a timeline added, or an editable tldraw file?"

## 6. Follow-ups
Edit `board.json`, rerun steps 3 to 5, keep the old version as `board.v<N>.json`. "Make it a funnel" = same sources, new type. "Add timeline" = dates or weeks from the brief only; none given means ask, or list them as assumed.

## 7. Optional upgrades
- Editable file: write `board.tldr` (tldraw JSON: document, page, geo shapes with `richText`, arrow shapes with `text`, `kind:"arc"`, arrow bindings with `snap:"none"`). File = `{tldrawFileFormatVersion:1, schema, records}` and `schema` MUST be the real one or tldraw.com fails to migrate it (empty `sequences` breaks on richText); use for tldraw 3.15: `{"schemaVersion":2,"sequences":{"com.tldraw.store":4,"com.tldraw.asset":1,"com.tldraw.camera":1,"com.tldraw.document":2,"com.tldraw.instance":25,"com.tldraw.instance_page_state":5,"com.tldraw.page":1,"com.tldraw.instance_presence":6,"com.tldraw.pointer":1,"com.tldraw.shape":4,"com.tldraw.asset.bookmark":2,"com.tldraw.asset.image":5,"com.tldraw.asset.video":5,"com.tldraw.shape.arrow":6,"com.tldraw.shape.bookmark":2,"com.tldraw.shape.draw":2,"com.tldraw.shape.embed":4,"com.tldraw.shape.frame":1,"com.tldraw.shape.geo":10,"com.tldraw.shape.group":0,"com.tldraw.shape.highlight":1,"com.tldraw.shape.image":5,"com.tldraw.shape.line":5,"com.tldraw.shape.note":9,"com.tldraw.shape.text":3,"com.tldraw.shape.video":4,"com.tldraw.binding.arrow":1}}`. Opens at tldraw.com via File, Open.
- If the tldraw plugin is installed, offer to draw the same board on its live canvas with its exec tool. Never require it.
Never invent client facts, never send or share a board without a yes.
